name: Sa Huynh Culture Museum

summary: The museum at 149 Trần Phú for the Sa Huỳnh culture, set up in 1994, with more than a thousand objects from about two thousand years ago and a few from Bãi Ông on Cù Lao Chàm that the overview dates to about three thousand years. body: The museum is at 149 Trần Phú. The heritage overview says it was set up by Decision 36/QĐ of 8 June 1994. The collection is more than a thousand objects from the Sa Huỳnh culture, which the page dates to about two thousand years ago, the people it calls the early residents of this port. The same page says the objects have archaeological addresses: each one is tied to where it was found.

A smaller group comes from Bãi Ông on Cù Lao Chàm. The overview dates those to the pre-Sa Huỳnh period, about three thousand years ago. The cases also cover burial customs and what the page calls the community’s sense of the beautiful. This is the prehistoric hour. It is not a substitute for the ruined towers at My Son.
The overview says the doors are open every day except the 10th of the month, and it does not print a clock. The fee sits in the ancient-town ticket disagreement. Both are check on arrival.

figures.caption: A Sa Huynh jar in a case
figures.alt: A footed ceramic jar with a wide rim, on display in the Sa Huynh Culture Museum

gettingThere: Walk to 149 Trần Phú. The overview does not print a minute count.

legs.heading: From the old town
legs.body: Walk along Trần Phú to number 149. The minutes depend on your lane.

closed: Closed on the 10th of each month. No weekly closing day is printed.
admissionNote: No separate price is printed for this building. From 10 August 2026, Da Nang Resolution 98/2026 sets 20,000 VND per person per building, the same for a Vietnamese and a foreign visitor. The heritage centre’s notices of 26 January 2026 and 16 March 2026 still describe an 80,000 VND ticket for the streetscape, Chùa Cầu or Miếu Quan Công, and two other works, and a 120,000 VND ticket when a museum and three other works are added. The March notice says one purchase can be used through the stay, up to three days. A May 2026 article says the town is an open neighbourhood and many people walk in without a ticket. Which desk is in force is check on arrival.
